# Jubayer Ahmad

> Dynamic business student with proven expertise in operations, brand strategy, content management, and team leadership. BBA student at IBA, University of Rajshahi.

## About

Jubayer Ahmad is a BBA student at IBA, University of Rajshahi who combines analytical strategy with storytelling flair. He has led operations at scale — managing large teams, coordinating complex workflows, and delivering results under pressure. His experience spans large-scale operations management, content strategy, brand campaigns, quality assurance, and cross-functional team leadership.
